title: biosig-zarr format version 2: channel group metadata document
description: The zarr.json of a channel group (the channels of one modality that share one sampling rate) in a format version 2 store, transcribed from spec/index.md at release 2.0.0, which is the definition. Rules that relate two values, such as the length of channels and n_channels, or the row_index values and n_channels, are not expressed. Attributes the text lists as possibly absent in a version 2 store are not required, and unknown attributes are allowed.
$comment: Hierarchy: a channel group is a Zarr group. Channel groups: the group attribute table.

zarr_format.$comment: Zarr requirements: a store MUST NOT use Zarr version 2 metadata.

node_type.$comment: Hierarchy: a channel group is a group.

attributes.$comment: Channel groups: the REQUIRED rows of the group attribute table, less n_view_levels, view_levels, view_downsample, view_chunk_columns, chunk_seconds and shard_seconds, which What changes the version lists as possibly absent.

channel.$comment: Channel groups: the REQUIRED rows of the channel object table.

row_index.$comment: Channel groups: the row_index values of a group MUST be the integers 0 to n_channels - 1.
